description: This file defines a Flutter widget, ReviewsScreen, which displays a list of static reviews with some styling and layout. It includes internal classes and methods related to presenting review rows and related visual components.

classes.name: ReviewsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a list of recent reviews with responsiveness to tablet size.

classes.name: _ReviewRow
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders individual review entries, including avatar, review text, and star ratings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for ReviewsScreen or _ReviewRow, defining UI layout and styling.
